descriptionChirho: To rebel or act in defiance against authority, especially against God or his commands; the basic Qal active sense covering all finite verb forms expressing the act of rebellion.
Adjectival/substantive use of the Qal participle describing a person or entity characterized as rebellious or defiant, often used as a noun 'rebel(s)'.
Causative Hifil stem expressing active rebellion against a superior, provoking or defying authority, often with the nuance of deliberate, willful disobedience against God.
Substantive use of the Hifil participle designating persons who are rebels or who actively provoke rebellion.

Stative or adjectival sense expressing the quality of being bitter, either literally (taste) or figuratively (of spirit, experience, or provocation); includes the nominal/infinitival use 'bitterness/provocation'.
